verdict.rationale: Beamer is a changelog, feedback and roadmap tool, so handing approved items into a delivery workflow is a fair question for it. The evidence shows feedback prioritization, public and private roadmaps, and generic integrations, API and webhooks. Nothing documents approved product specifications or pulling them into a development workflow to start implementation. Generic integration claims are building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull an approved product specification into the delivery workflow to start implementation
